newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Goncz vetoes second bill in two days.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Goncz vetoes second bill in two days.

text.p: Hungarian President Arpad Goncz vetoed a second bill in two days when he rejected a set of amendments to the privatisation law, a presidential source said.
An official at the president's office told Reuters that the president had sent the bill back to the National Assembly for further consideration. The official could not give any further information.
Goncz used his veto on Thursday to return a conflict of interest bill to parliament.
The privatisation amendments, approved by assembly on December 19, had been fiercely attacked by opposition parties.
The opposition's main objection was that the amendments would leave too much room for the government to transfer state assets to local authorities and agricultural cooperatives.
The opposition parties threatened to take their complaints to the Constitutional Court if Goncz signed the bill.
